'''Quockra-4''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Quockra system/Legends|Quockra system]], located in the remote [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] of the southern [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
==Description==
Quockra-4 was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], flat without much differentiation of terrain. It never rained and there weren't any [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], though there were several extremely large [[Salt/Legends|salt]] flats. It would become extremely hot during the midday hours, making it dangerous for unprotected [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. At night the temperature was so cold that protective clothing was required. There was only one [[Quockra-4 city|city]], located near the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], which was built largely underground to escape the extremes of temperature. This world was assumed by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to be populated entirely by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of a thousand different varieties. Many of the droids were of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] manufacture, but some were of unknown design.<ref name="GG6" />
The only natives of Quockra-4 were the [[Quockran|Quockrans]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of giant [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]] with large, [[black]] bodies. As of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] their existence was unknown to many due to the Quockrans' reclusive behavior.

==Society==
The [[Quockran|Quockrans]] were a [[Speciesism|xenophobic]] species that used avoided contact with other species if at all possible. They were indifferent to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] affairs and refused to get involved in [[Politics/Legends|political]] causes such as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].

To facilitate their isolation, the Quockrans manufactured an entire society of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to interact with offworlders<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> in their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] sole [[Quockra-4 city|city]]. Composed of thousands of different designs, both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] models and other, more exotic styles, and numbering over ten million individual units,<ref name="GG6" /> the droids appeared to manage all the affairs of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="AE" /> The automata followed a clearly delineated hierarchy: three-armed [[yellow repair droid]]s were superior, giving out orders in their [[Binary/Legends|machine language]]; [[Red worker droid|red worker models]] were in the middle; Imperial droids were at the bottom, functioning as translators for those of higher rank.<ref name="GG6" /> With this system in place, the Quockrans were able to live far below ground, only emerging on the surface at night to loll about in the cooling [[Desert/Legends|desert]] sands.<ref name="GG6" />
